tickets.issue: Laptop cannot connect to university Wi‑Fi from campus; wireless adapter appears to be device-specific (other devices can connect). No authentication errors reported. Tried: confirmed Wi‑Fi enabled, selected correct network, disconnected/reconnected (including forgetting the network), moved closer to access point, restarted wireless adapter, restarted laptop, and verified others can connect.
tickets.troubleshooting_attempted: Confirmed user is on campus and Wi‑Fi should be available; Wi‑Fi enabled; correct network selected; disconnected and rejoined network; moved closer to access point; restarted wireless adapter (toggled Wi‑Fi/Airplane mode); restarted laptop; verified other users/devices can connect; no authentication/password errors observed.

tickets.issue: Laptop cannot resolve a public hostname by name (access works by IP); the hostname resolves from other devices on the same network but not from this laptop.
tickets.troubleshooting_attempted: Confirmed network connectivity; opened other public websites successfully; DNS servers on laptop match another working device; cleared local DNS cache; verified other device on same network can reach the hostname by name; attempted to run DNS diagnostic (nslookup) but user could not provide output.
